messages:
leila: Noticed ~120 users lost editor role after nightly AAD group sync. Saw mass SCIM PATCH → roles: [] entries. Anyone on call? :alarm_clock:
hugo: Oof. Any correlation with KMS events or recent deploys?
nina: Pulling audit. Quick grep shows KMS rewrap errors at 02:04Z for alias/scim-key-v2. Example:
``n2026-03-22T02:04:12Z kms: Rewrap alias/scim-key-v2 -> AccessDenied
2026-03-22T02:04:12Z scim: PATCH /Users/uid-444 roles=[] reason=group-sync
```
leila: We rotated the key last week; infra told us to set NEW_ALIAS but the group-sync job still references the old alias in cluster configmap.
infra: Confirmed. helm release group-sync still has KMS_ALIAS=alias/scim-key-v1 in values. I can push patch but want to run quick impact check.
hugo: Also, security note: while investigating I hit a weird SAML parsing dependency warning (saml-parser v1.2.3) flagged by vulnerability-scan. CVE suggests assertion canonicalization bug. Could be medium severity for forged attributes. Tagging this as vuln-triage.
sec-bot: New finding: VULN-2026-12 detected in saml-parser v1.2.3 used by idp-proxy; recommended upgrade to >=1.2.7.
nina: Timeline: 02:03Z KMS rewrap fails → 02:04Z group-sync falls back to remove groups when primary extid check errors → 02:05Z mass role removals logged.
leila: Immediate steps: 1) lock group-sync (scale to 0) 2) apply correct KMS_ALIAS to helm values and force deploy 3) restore roles from backup / audit replay 4) triage saml-parser vuln and plan upgrade.
infra: Scaling down job now. pods terminating.
hugo: For restore: I have a snapshot of RBAC state from 01:50Z. I can run a replay script to reapply group memberships idempotently. Will run in dry-run first.
ina: Audit query I used to find affected tenants:
``nSELECT user_id, tenant, before_roles, after_roles FROM rbac_audit
WHERE timestamp BETWEEN '2026-03-22T01:55:00Z' AND '2026-03-22T02:10:00Z' AND after_roles = '[]'
```
leila: Good. Also check whether any long-lived service tokens were minted after 02:00Z and revoke if needed.
infra: Helm override ready. Pushing values -> KMS_ALIAS=alias/scim-key-v2-fixed and forcing rollout. Will post when pods back up.
sec-bot: Alert created: SEC-2026-032 1 120 users lost roles due to group-sync KMS failure. Linked to VULN-2026-12.
hugo: On the saml-parser vuln: quick repro shows malformed assertion with nested signatures bypasses attribute checks in v1.2.3. I'll open PR to bump dependency and add a test. If upgrade breaks anything we'll feature-flag behind idp-proxy config.
leila: After infra reports pods healthy we'll run restore. Hugo, coordinate with me on replay window. Nina, prepare customer communication for affected orgs.
ina: Will draft notice: explain root cause (KMS alias misconfig + fallback behavior) and mitigation (rotated keys, restored roles, patched fallback logic).
infra: Pods back up, group-sync job now uses alias/scim-key-v2-fixed. I verified env on 4 replicas.
hugo: Dry-run replay shows 118 users would have roles restored. Ready for run with lock and monitoring.
leila: Do it. Run with --monitoring and throttle 50/s. Command: 
``npython ops/replay_rbac.py --since 2026-03-22T01:50:00 --until 2026-03-22T02:10:00 --throttle 50 --monitoring true
```
hugo: Running now (dry-run disabled). Watching metrics.
sec-bot: Notification: RBAC replay started. 118 users queued.
infra: Also added a gating check: if KMS AccessDenied reappears, abort replay.
nina: Customer notice drafted; requesting approval.
leila: Approve. Send at T+2h and include remediation steps and contact. Also add postmortem action items: - remove silent fallback in group-sync, - add KMS decrypt alert + role-change correlation, - pin saml-parser and upgrade asap.
hugo: PR opened for saml-parser upgrade with unit tests. Marking as high priority.
sec-bot: Incident ticket INC-2026-047 created and linked. Pager duty will be notified.
pagerduty: Received incident INC-2026-047. Escalation: oncall-eng and sec-lead.
leila: Thanks team. After restore we'll run a full scan for strange token issuance and follow up. :white_check_mark:
